Class BedrockDeathScreenStages

java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.screen.death.BedrockDeathScreenStages
public final class BedrockDeathScreenStages extends Object
Projects the Bedrock death screen stages onto Java's death screen controls.

The keyboard and mouse layout shows the reason after 500 ms and the buttons after 1000 ms. Non-hardcore worlds offer Respawn and Game menu; hardcore worlds offer Exit world first and Spectate world second. A respawn request hides both, then shows a progress line until the player is alive.

  • Method Details

    • arrange

      public static void arrange(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.DeathScreen screen, int delay, boolean pending)
      Labels and orders Java's two buttons after each init. Java restarts its button delay whenever it rebuilds widgets, for example after a resize or when the game menu closes. The native stage does not restart.
